analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY in uptrend (+2.32% 20d slope) — constructive backdrop, but the portfolio-level picture demands caution over aggression.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW:
• A (+1.35%): Uptrend basing, thesis intact. ATR stop likely around $120-122. No action.
• AMP (+1.40%): Modest gain, quality financial. Thesis intact. Watch for extended move.
• CI (-4.14%): Down $12.26/share from avg cost. Healthcare has been under broad pressure. Prior CI trade also exited at stop (+1.67%). Not yet at thesis break but watching closely — if it violates the $270-275 range (SMA support), stop discipline applies. Monitor earnings Sep 17.
• FDS (+2.07%): Clean basing uptrend, quality metrics strong. Thesis intact.
• LII (-5.50%): Most concerning position. This is the THIRD LII entry in the trade journal — previous two were both stop-outs (-6.63% and +4.82% stop hit). Now -5.50% again. Pattern of failed entries on this name is a yellow flag. At $543.93 vs avg $575.57, the position is approaching the pain zone. No fundamental thesis break yet (HVAC cycle intact), but the repeated technical failures warrant tighter monitoring.
• WDAY (+0.68%): Flat but uptrend basing, strong FCF ($3.1B), low fwd P/E (11.45x). Thesis intact.

NEW TRADE CAPACITY ASSESSMENT: Only $4,174 of headroom (4.1% of equity). Portfolio already at 91% deployed across 6 positions — already above the 3-5 position target. Any new position could be sized at best $4,000, which at a proper 1.5% risk formula would produce a trivially small position (e.g., 20 shares of something at ~$200 with a $15 stop). This is not a meaningful allocation and would only add noise. VEEV and ZBRA are genuinely interesting setups (VEEV: PEG 0.88, D/E 1.41, fwd P/E 19.47, uptrend basing; ZBRA: fwd P/E 12.91, PEG 0.57, revenue growing 14.3%) but neither can be properly sized today. Forcing a sub-$5k entry on a $100k account violates the spirit of concentrated position discipline. DECISION: No new buys. Cash is the position. Revisit when LII or CI frees capital via their existing stops, creating real headroom for a proper entry in VEEV or ZBRA.
